text:
The Ducks have won four in a row, the latest against Calgary, and they are 9-7-1 with a 53% shot at the playoffs. They're fun. They are also living a little dangerously.

Anaheim has scored 64 and allowed 64, but the chances say it should be worse: 47.95% of the expected goals (the quality of chances for and against), and only 45% at 5-on-5. Finishing has carried them, 9.99 goals above what the shots deserved. Even the winning streak runs on it, 21 goals on 12.8 expected. Cutter Gauthier (13 points in his last 10) and Tristan Luneau (10 in 10, on 4.4 expected) are riding high.

The worry list is short and specific. They take 5.24 penalties a game, and the goalies have allowed 5.36 more goals than expected. The top pair of Jackson LaCombe and Noah Warren has controlled just 37% of the expected goals together, while LaCombe with Luneau has gone 8-3 in goals.

What to watch: whether Leo Carlsson's line with Alex Killorn and Judd Caulfield (59% of expected goals) gets more ice. That is the most sustainable thing on this roster right now.
headline: Four straight, but look closer
